rv.q: Whether you’re a devoted dance fan or, like me, something of a dance sceptic, this is a joyous, exhilarating and deeply uplifting show.
If the story were fashionista foresakes starkness for colour, that would work splendidly, but trying to overlay A Christmas Carol on the relentless dance numbers is effortful and underwhelming.
Ebony Scrooge is a bold, energetic, and thoroughly entertaining alternative to traditional Christmas theatre.
Rhimes' Ebony Scrooge is both personal and a powerhouse.
This is truly an ensemble show, brilliant in its conception, immaculately produced and impeccable in its execution.
Nevertheless, Ebony Scrooge offers an inventive and entertaining alternative to traditional Christmas theatre.

cn.t: Critics praise Ebony Scrooge as a visually ambitious, bold retelling of A Christmas Carol, blending hip hop, comedy and physical theatre to thrilling effect.
